notes: Extended the iteration-1 suite per retest instructions: all 8 iteration-1 artifacts re-ran green (3 backend + 5 browser), then added 4 new backend test files (9 new test functions) and 2 new named browser checks covering the newly-introduced acceptance criteria (Radar API shape, Vision endpoints, Agent Business tester incl. validation, admin diagnostics incl. secret-leak assertion, git secret-tracking hygiene).

13 acceptance-matrix criteria in the briefing all covered: 8 have backend-test artifacts (Radar API, Vision endpoints, Agent Business tester incl. 422 validation, diagnostics role-gating, diagnostics no-leak/shape, git secrets untracked/ignored/on-disk -- git-secrets criterion covered by 3 test functions in one file) and 5 UI-facing criteria have browser checks (login, cockpit, no-cors, private-routes regression guards retained; Radar UI, Agent Business UI, Vision board UI are the new/kept browser checks).

One transient debugging detour during Agent Business browser-check authoring: an inline run without the url= override silently hit the unrelated template app on port 3000 (different login page, different demo agent 'Zaza') instead of the zayado app on 3001, producing confusing selector timeouts. Root-caused via console.log(page.url()) and fixed by always passing url='http://localhost:3001' for zayado checks -- not an application defect, purely a check-authoring pitfall now avoided in the persisted script.
